verified_facts: DeepSpec is a full-stack codebase for training and evaluating draft models for speculative decoding.
The workflow is data preparation, training, and evaluation of speculative-decoding acceptance on benchmark tasks.
Default configs and scripts assume a single node with 8 GPUs; fewer GPUs require reducing CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
Default Qwen/Qwen3-4B data preparation warns target cache storage can be roughly 38 TB.
Released DSpark checkpoints are listed for Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and google/gemma-4-12B-it targets.
Supported DeepSpec draft algorithms currently include DSpark, DFlash, and Eagle3.

commands.note: DeepSpec repository observed in DeepSeek org listing; initial standalone-DSpark search was insufficient.

baseline_scope.allowed: Use DSpark/DeepSpec as an external speculative-decoding and draft-model training/evaluation baseline for inference throughput, acceptance, and agent-loop sampling cost.
baseline_scope.disallowed: Do not use DSpark as direct proof that Ember can train a >=1B foundation model on one RTX 4090 in days. That transfer requires same-axis RTX 4090 training receipts.

correction: The first DSpark lookup was stale/shallow because it searched for a standalone DSpark source and missed DSpark inside DeepSeek DeepSpec. The baseline packet now records this as a coverage failure mode and pins the resolved source.
